description: This file defines the Bootstrap modal component (version 3.2.0), including the Modal class, its methods for showing, hiding, and managing modal dialogs, and the jQuery plugin interface for modal functionality.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Class representing the Bootstrap modal component, managing modal dialog behavior and interactions.

methods.name: enforceFocus
methods.description: Ensure focus stays within the modal when open.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Handle escape key press to close modal if enabled.

methods.name: hideModal
methods.description: Hide the modal element and trigger hidden event.

methods.name: backdrop
methods.description: Create or remove the modal backdrop with optional callback.

methods.name: checkScrollbar
methods.description: Check if scrollbar is present and measure its width.

methods.name: setScrollbar
methods.description: Adjust body padding to account for scrollbar width.

methods.name: measureScrollbar
methods.description: Calculate scrollbar width by creating a temporary element.
